conclusion.canonical: The Kyiv mayor's official account reported fifteen injured people and nine remaining in hospitals in a 5 August update. The frozen evidence confirms publication of those figures, while the casualty totals themselves remain unverified and unapproved.

The Guardian attributed to President Volodymyr Zelenskyy criticism of delayed air-defence deliveries and requests for additional air-defence support and sanctions. The frozen evidence confirms the article's attributions; the underlying presidential statements remain probable, in review, and excluded from approved report inputs.
